title: Cluster Snapshot Inspector & Rollback Palette (compact console prototype)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, information-dense inspector card and accompanying rollback palette for Private/VPC cluster pages. The artifact will live in the cluster list and the cluster detail header for quick operator recovery: a single compact snapshot that surfaces health metrics, recent upgrade state, cost delta for recent changes, and a contextual action palette (soft rollback, pause upgrades, open incident runbook). The design should be mobile-responsive for on-call use, keyboard-accessible, and minimize visual noise while retaining clear affordances for destructive actions.
acceptance_criteria: Compact inspector renders at three densities (compact / regular / expanded) and matches token sizes in console design system
Shows at-a-glance SLO status, median p95 latency, KV cache hit rate, and recent upgrade artifact hash
Cost delta estimation shows projected 24h cost change when applying rollback vs keeping current rollout
Action palette includes confirmable soft rollback, freeze upgrades, open runbook, and view detailed telemetry links
Prototype wired to show simulated network/egress numbers for tenant-scoped views
Design passes accessibility check (contrast, focus states, keyboard flow) and has annotated interaction specs for engineering
decisions: Use three density modes to allow the card to fit both cluster list and cluster detail header without duplication
Show cost delta as single-line micro-chart + numeric projection to avoid heavy computation in UI
Soft rollback will be a staged action: preview -> impact projection -> require typed confirmation for cross-tenant rollbacks
Prefer inline telemetry links over embedding graphs to keep initial render light; clicking expands to telemetry panel
Action palette will be contextual and permission-aware (hide destructive actions if RBAC forbids)
Avoid modal-heavy flows; prefer flyout palettes and controlled inline confirmations to reduce disruption during incidents
next_steps: Incorporate PM feedback on exact KPIs to display (PM to confirm KV cache vs prefix hit metrics by 2025-02-07)
Handoff annotated Figma frames and interaction spec to ENG for a lightweight feature flagged rollout
Coordinate with Eng to add telemetry link targets (runtime traces, cost forecast job)
Run accessibility pass with DesignOps and record a short demo video of keyboard flows
Schedule a 30-minute design review with infra/eng on 2025-02-09 to finalize edge cases
review_comments: PM (Ananya Patel): Strong need for tenant-scoped egress numbers—please surface top-3 egress destinations in expanded view.
Eng (Ravi Kapoor): Concern about cost projection compute on the client; prefer server-side pre-computed delta for consistent numbers.
Security (Lena Hoff): Require audit-log linkage for any rollback action; add explicit mention in the confirmation text.
Design Lead (Renée Dubois): Keep destructive action out of primary click area; add secondary affordance and microcopy explaining rollback scope.
